A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same Inst-IT research work, with 27 complete pages including Appendices A–E. Text extraction and rendered-page comparisons support reliable comparison of the text, equations, figures, and tables.

before.justification: v2 reports original model evaluations and ablations in Tables 2–7, dataset analyses, and a human assessment of annotation quality in Table 10.

after.justification: v3 retains the original model evaluations, ablations, dataset analyses, and human annotation-quality assessment reported in v2.

M1.justification: The GPT-4o annotation pipeline, SoM visual prompting, LLaVA-NeXT architecture, and continuous instruction-tuning procedure remain identical in Sections 3–4 and Appendix A.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same image and video data sources and evaluate the same tasks: Inst-ITBench, generic image/video benchmarks, ViP-Bench, and RefCOCOg. Coverage in Sections 3–4 and Appendix C is unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical within every corresponding experiment. Tables 2–5 retain the same baseline and comparison-model rows, including LLaVA-NeXT, ViP-LLaVA, SoM-LLaVA, and proprietary models where originally evaluated.

E3.justification: The data splits, evaluation metrics, model configurations, training setup, 32-frame limit, and 6K context length are unchanged. The benchmark construction and scoring procedures in Appendix B also match.

E4.justification: Tables 6–7 retain the same training-recipe and data-component ablations. The appendix dataset analyses, human quality assessment, and failure-case observations are also unchanged.

E5.justification: Both retain the assessment of 500 samples by three volunteers and the same mean and standard-deviation reporting in Section 3.2 and Table 10. No run-count, seed, or uncertainty-reporting information changes.

E6.justification: All benchmark scores and ablation results in Tables 2–7 match, as does the RefCOCOg result in Section 4.3. Appendix statistics, human ratings, and qualitative findings are identical; no results are added, removed, or corrected.

T1.justification: The annotation definitions and mathematical formulations in Equations 1–3 are identical. Neither version adds or revises formal assumptions, derivations, theorems, or proofs relative to the other.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same dataset, benchmark, and training-recipe contributions and the same claims about improving instance understanding and general image/video comprehension.

C2.justification: Result interpretations remain identical, including the discussion of generalization and distribution shifts. Appendices D–E retain the same failure conditions, application discussion, model-size constraints, GPT-4o overhead, and broader-impact qualifications.

D1.justification: Implementation settings, hardware and training-time disclosures, annotation prompts, API version, and data-processing instructions are unchanged. The project website also remains the same; the correspondence-line edit does not revise technical or resource-access instructions.

R1.justification: Section 2 and the reference list are identical. The positioning relative to SoM-LLaVA, Elysium, and other prior work, including the claimed novelty of joint image/video instance annotations, is unchanged.

P1.justification: v3 removes Wujian Peng’s email from the first-page correspondence line, retaining Zuxuan Wu’s email, and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. The author list, body wording, and section structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–10 and Tables 1–13 retain their displays, captions, formatting, and placement. Pages 2–27 render pixel-identically, and the first-page administrative text edits preserve the page layout.

improvement.justification: v3 changes only first-page correspondence information and the arXiv version/date stamp. The scientific content, empirical evidence, reproducibility information, limitations, and presentation remain unchanged, so these administrative edits produce no meaningful overall quality difference.
